title: Stemming and Dink Correction
notes: Corrects the import calculator default to 7 ft minimum stemming and a 1 ft hold into rock.
Calculates stemming as the greater of the minimum or overburden plus the rock hold.
Calculates Primary Load as drilled depth minus stemming and stores the result as ANFO footage with an A designator.
Treats each manually entered dink as 3 ft and recalculates ANFO as depth minus stemming minus dink footage.
Supports dink-only Secondary Load entries such as 1D or 2D without repeatedly subtracting from an earlier ANFO value.
Previews loaded holes, total ANFO footage, Dirt/Bad skips, and holes requiring review before import.
Leaves timing blank and never calculates Dirt or Bad holes.
Uses the existing Drill Log import undo snapshot to restore the prior Shot Diagram.
Preserves inferred two-tap timing, Page Order / Renumber, iPad entry layout, right-click shortcuts, and cloud sync behavior.
